title: Strengthen the history-load structural test's independence proof or narrow its claim
outcome: The maintained history-load test accurately proves or describes its relationship to concurrent scan work without changing the separately scheduled latency measurement.
acceptance: The maintained structural test either deterministically detects registration waiting for an existing scan, without a wall-clock bound, or is named and documented to claim only its actual handshake and overlap checks.
The separately scheduled 3200-run latency fixture retains the agreed received-triggered scan release and its real parsing, SQL, ACK/GET, ring and cleanup assertions.
